Package com.example.eventlottery.domain

Class EventSummary

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventlottery.domain.EventSummary
public class EventSummary extends Object
Lightweight model for showing events in lists. Extended to support filtering by category, location, date, registration availability, lottery criteria, geolocation requirement, and co-organizer support. User stories supported: - US 01.01.03: See a list of events to join the waiting list for - US 01.01.04: Filter events based on interests and availability - US 01.05.05: Be informed about lottery selection criteria - US 02.02.03: Organizer enables or disables geolocation requirement - US 02.09.01: Organizer adds co-organizers to an event
Version:
1.4
Author:
Kenneth Joseph, Fawaz Mansoor
